## Issue Link 🔗:

**Issue**: #[Issue_Number]

## Type of change

Please check all options that are relevant.

- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Documentation or website update
- [ ] Experiment, load profile or notebook
- [ ] Refactoring
- [ ] Other

## Description

- **What:** Provide an overview of the issue this PR addresses. Explain the context and background information.

- **Why:** Describe why the changes are being made. Highlight key updates, new features, or bug fixes.

- **How:** Explain how these changes will affect the project or end-users, and how you tested them.

## Checklist

- [ ] My code follows the [contributing guide](https://github.com/danielcristho/croft/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) and [code of conduct](https://github.com/danielcristho/croft/blob/main/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md) of this project.
- [ ] Every commit follows Conventional Commits and is signed off (`git commit -s`).
- [ ] I have updated any relevant documentation (`website/`, `README.md`).
- [ ] Ran `just lint` and `just test` locally (if `collector/` changed)
- [ ] Ran a change to the eBPF program on a real kernel (if applicable)
- [ ] Ran `npm run build` in `website/` locally (if the website changed)
- [ ] I said below if an AI tool wrote a substantial part of this change.
